_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session B3: the two Russian adaptations of Qwen2.5-7B on exposure_2, one per card, on the prompts their base answered in B2. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct named 11 of 250 OKVED 2 codes against the 3.4% lookup baseline (p = 0.23), like Mistral-Nemo (12); the YandexGPT pair named 28 and 32 (reports/RESULTS_EXPOSURE.md Part VIII). The question is whether Russian adaptation of a multilingual base adds what a from-scratch Russian model has: OKVED 2 and MKB-10 names from codes, and the classifier rows of exposure_2, paired with Qwen on identical prompts. On the canon both adaptations kept their base's iris (T-lite 67/103, ruadapt 50/103 against Qwen's 58/103; reports/RESULTS_CANON.md §8). Planning figures from src/price_plan.py with each model's own tokenizer, every answer to its budget x 1.15; validated on 37 runs (actual/plan 0.71-0.94; B2's three runs 0.75): T-lite 5.7 h, ruadapt 5.5 h (its extended vocabulary encodes Cyrillic in fewer tokens). The longer card is 5.7 h. Qwen's exposure_2 run, priced the same way, took 4 h 20 min.
attached_input: the nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached as one Kaggle dataset (loose or zipped); the fetch step adopts them from /kaggle/input, looks inside zips, and verifies every hash before any weights load
disk: two checkpoints at once, about 31 GB at the peak (T-lite 15.2 + ruadapt-Qwen 15.5, neither with custom code)

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: feature completion on the four classifiers and header and row on the rest of exposure_2; 5.7 h; Qwen2.5-7B's continued-pretraining adaptation, paired with Qwen's B2 run. iris anchors the plan (95/142 in B1)
the same cells, same seed, the other card; 5.5 h; Qwen2.5-7B's vocabulary-extended adaptation. iris anchors the plan (76/142 in B2). Needs the T4 x2 accelerator
